description: This file defines a class `ImagesJpeg` that extends a `Snippet` class, responsible for rendering multiple JPEG images within a PDF document using the PdfSharp library. It demonstrates drawing different types of JPEG images with various color and transparency options.

classes.name: ImagesJpeg
classes.description: A class that renders several JPEG images with different properties in a drawing snippet.

methods.name: RenderSnippet
methods.description: Draws multiple JPEG images onto the provided graphics context in a tiled layout.
